app.offline: Uni VPN is not running. Restart the computer, or run: uni-vpn service start
app.not_running_start: uni-vpn is not running. Run: uni-vpn service start
setup.find_help: Not in the list? Choose "Not listed" and enter the address your university gives for Cisco AnyConnect or Cisco Secure Client.
setup.choose: Choose your university, or Not listed
setup.saml: This university signs in through a browser, uni-vpn does not support that yet.
setup.sign_in_sub: Your university account, the same as for email.
setup.enter_user: Enter your username, for example ab123
setup.totp_sub: Add this computer as a token, like a second phone.
setup.totp_help: No otpauth:// line? Copy the letters after "secret=" instead. Already have a token on your phone? Add a second one for this computer; both keep working.
setup.generic_step.1: Open your university's {portal} and add a time-based token (TOTP) for this computer.
setup.generic_step.2: Copy the line starting with otpauth://, or the letters after secret=.
setup.waiting: Testing the connection. This can take a minute.
setup.all_set_sub: University websites now open through the VPN by themselves. Close and reopen your browser once.
setup.all_set_no_domains: Add the websites that should go through the university under Settings, Websites.
main.hint.idle: Connects by itself when you open a university website.
main.hint.connected: University websites go through the VPN.
settings.title: Settings
settings.domains_help: One domain per line, subdomains included. Everything else goes direct.
state.port_in_use: Port {port} is in use, run uni-vpn doctor
state.wintun_admin: Needs administrator rights (Wintun): run the installer again
state.blocked: Cisco Secure Client is connected, uni-vpn is paused
state.otp_wait: Waiting for the next one-time code (up to 30 s)
state.no_totp: No TOTP secret stored: uni-vpn totp
state.keyring_locked: Keyring locked, please unlock it and connect again
state.login_failed_exit: Login failed (openconnect exit code 1), see uni-vpn log
tunnel.password_rejected: Login rejected: check your password (uni-vpn password)
tunnel.totp_rejected: One-time code rejected: check the computer's clock, otherwise re-enter the TOTP secret (uni-vpn totp)
tunnel.append_rejected: Login rejected: check your password, then the computer's clock (uni-vpn password)
tunnel.duo_rejected: Login rejected: check your password, or the Duo request was denied or not answered in time (uni-vpn password)
tunnel.auth_rejected: Login rejected: check your password (uni-vpn password). If it is correct, the server asked for something uni-vpn does not know, see uni-vpn log
tunnel.saml: This university signs in through a browser (SAML), uni-vpn does not support that yet
tunnel.hostscan: The server requires HostScan (CSD), uni-vpn does not support that
tunnel.totp_invalid: TOTP secret unusable, enter it again (uni-vpn totp)
totp.line_break: Secret must not contain a line break
totp.digits: Only 6 digits and 30 seconds are supported
totp.not_secret: That is not the secret. Copy the line starting with otpauth://, or the letters after secret=
totp.incomplete: The secret is incomplete. Copy the whole line
password.line_break: Password must not contain a line break
address.invalid: Enter the VPN address, for example vpn.example.edu
address.path: The path after the address may only contain letters, digits and . _ ~ + -
